title: Tech Note: Building a Simple Browser with 4D Live Window
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a development-diary style note walking through building a simple embedded web browser UI using the 4D Live Window plug-in, focusing on its event callback model (Before/During/After/Error) for tracking browser navigation state. 4D Live Window was a Web 2.0 Pack component for embedding a native browser control inside 4D forms, a need now served natively by 4D's built-in Web Area / Web Area 4D View components in modern 4D versions without requiring a separate plug-in. The specific plug-in, its licensing model, and its command set (WEB_SetURL, WEB_Back, WEB_SetPreferences) are obsolete, though the underlying event-driven navigation-tracking pattern described remains conceptually applicable to any embedded browser control.
related_updates: The 4D Live Window plug-in and 4D Web 2.0 Pack subscription products have been discontinued
Current 4D versions provide a built-in Web Area form object for embedding browser content, removing the need for a separate plug-in and its custom WEB_* commands
